[amulet_z_ruin].description.t: The daughter of the old watchtower guard knew the mark on your amulet. Go to the Watchtower Ruins, a day's walk south, see whether it fits the wall, and come back to her.

[amulet_z_ruin].objectives.[corka].text.t: Go back to the guard's daughter and decide what to do with the amulet.

[amulet_z_ruin].objectives.[ruiny].text.t: Hold the amulet to the wall in the Watchtower Ruins.

[buty_dla_wartownika].description.t: The cobbler Mojżesz asks you to carry a parcel: the sentry's boots are waiting for their recipient at a place called the Crossing on the Grey.

[buty_dla_wartownika].objectives.[dostaw.t: Deliver: the sentry's boots (Crossing on the Grey).

[cesarski_dezerter].description.t: Tomasz, a scout, ran from his imperial company and is now hiding at Starwatch. You can help him disappear, or hand him over.

[cesarski_dezerter].objectives.[tomasz]..t: Talk to Tomasz and decide what to do with him.

[chleb_dla_grabarza].description.t: The baker Luiza asks you to carry a parcel: a loaf for the gravedigger is waiting for its recipient at a place called the Common Graveyard.

[chleb_dla_grabarza].objectives.[dostawa.t: Deliver: a loaf for the gravedigger (Common Graveyard).

[cmentarz_bez_nazwisk].description.t: In the Common Graveyard lie people nobody wrote down. The gravedigger wants to write down the names. The scribe thinks that's dangerous, because a name leaves a trail.

[cmentarz_bez_nazwisk].objectives.[rozli.t: Report to the scribe in the chancery.

[cmentarz_bez_nazwisk].objectives.[rozst.t: Settle the matter on the spot: A Graveyard Without Names.

[co_widziala_ragnoslawa].description.t: In the Głuszec graveyard a voice from the stones spoke of Ragnosława and of a place where something fell. Sister Halina may know what it means.

[co_widziala_ragnoslawa].objectives.[hal.t: Tell Sister Halina about the voice from the stones.

[dlug_istoty_zlecenie].description.t: The core from the wreck spoke in the Being's voice. You can acknowledge the debt and gain knowledge, or refuse it and stay free.

[dlug_istoty_zlecenie].objectives.[glos].t: Listen to the voice from the core in Brygida's workshop, and decide.

[dlug_kupca].description.t: Wrzosek the innkeeper wants his money back from Ostromir, a travelling merchant. The promissory note goes one way, the receipt comes back the other.

[dlug_kupca].objectives.[weksel].text.t: Take the promissory note to Ostromir the merchant on the road.

[dlug_mlynarza].description.t: Grumble the innkeeper wants his twelve groats back from Radosz the miller. Radosz has trouble with his mill, and it's on you to decide whether to lean on him or give him time.

[dlug_mlynarza].objectives.[mruk].text.t: Tell Grumble how the talk went.

[dlug_mlynarza].objectives.[radosz].text.t: Remind Radosz the miller of his debt.

[dlug_przekupki].description.t: The market woman Turnip has a debtor who hasn't paid in four months, because he knows she has no one to send. The scribe offered that he has someone. That's you.

[dlug_przekupki].objectives.[rozlicz].te.t: Report to the scribe in the chancery.

[dlug_przekupki].objectives.[rozstrzygni.t: Settle the matter on the spot: The Market Woman's Debt.

[dwoch_dezerterow].description.t: An imperial lieutenant has lost two men and says it's the captain's doing. The captain says it's the lieutenant's. Somebody has to settle it, and you're at hand and wear no uniform.

[dwoch_dezerterow].objectives.[rozstrzyg.t: Settle the matter on the spot: Two Deserters.

[dwoch_dezerterow].objectives.[zamelduj].t: Report to the captain in the command tent on how it went.

[eskorta_ostromira].description.t: See Ostromir the merchant's wagon safely to Stone Pass. He'll wait in Wolf's Ford for three days, then he goes on alone.

[eskorta_ostromira].events.[napad_na_woz.t: The thugs run off into the bushes, losing their masks. Ostromir crawls out from under the wagon, dusts off his coat and announces that he knew all along you'd manage.
"I'll walk back to the Ford," he says at last, to the ditch. "My brother-in-law will wait anyway."
By the time you come to, the wagon is gone. Ostromir sits in the ditch with no boots and no goods, and won't look at you.
By the time you're back on the road, the wagon is gone. Ostromir sits in the ditch with no boots and no goods, and won't look at you.

Two thugs in sackcloth masks jump out from under a little bridge. One grabs the horse by the bridle, the other points a pitchfork at you. Ostromir dives under the wagon and prays out loud to every god at once.

[eskorta_ostromira].scenes.[przelecz_dot.t: Ostromir's wagon rolls up onto the pass, where his brother-in-law waits with two mules. The merchant counts every coin three times over, but pays to the last groat and throws in a sack of dried meat for the road.

[falszywe_papiery].description.t: Sister Halina gives you the wax, and Bogdan the smith knows how to make a seal out of it. With forged papers it's easier to get past the scouts' checks.

[falszywe_papiery].objectives.[kowal].te.t: Take the wax to Bogdan the smith so he can make the papers.

[furman_z_beczkami].description.t: At the crossing stands a carter with a wagon of barrels, no papers, and the look of a man who stopped hurrying long ago. The captain wants to know who gets them before anyone starts counting who paid for them.

[furman_z_beczkami].objectives.[rozstrzy.t: Settle the matter on the spot: The Carter with the Barrels.

[furman_z_beczkami].objectives.[zamelduj.t: Report to the captain in the command tent on how it went.

[gwozdzie_dla_stoczni].description.t: Gudrun the smith asks you to deliver a package: a box of nails is waiting for its recipient at the place called the Shipyard.

[jar_bez_wyjscia].description.t: Sergeant Gniewosz and thirty-two deserters have food for nine days and pursuit on their heels. They can come back with a safe-conduct from the captain, or flee beyond the hills if someone brings six sacks of provisions. Or you can tell the captain how to get in to them.

[jar_bez_wyjscia].name.t: A Ravine with No Way Out

[jar_bez_wyjscia].objectives.[rozstrzygn.t: Decide the deserters' fate: a letter from the captain, provisions for Gniewosz, or a report to the command.

[klusownik_i_gajowy].description.t: Radowit the gamekeeper wants to know who's setting snares in Poachers' Wood. He won't accuse anyone without proof, so he's sending you.

[klusownik_i_gajowy].objectives.[gajowy].t: Tell the gamekeeper what you found out.

[klusownik_i_gajowy].objectives.[stach]..t: Talk to Stach the poacher in Poachers' Wood.

[kobialka_dla_zielarki].description.t: A travelling herbalist with a bad knee asks you to carry a basket of herbs to the marsh herbalist's hut.

[kobialka_dla_zielarki].objectives.[dost.t: Take the basket of herbs to the herbalist in the Greywater Marshes.

[kowal_i_rusznice].description.t: The smith at the Islanders' Forges has an order for a hundred handguns and less and less appetite for hammering. The captain suspects he is waiting for somebody to tell him what to do.

[kowal_i_rusznice].objectives.[rozlicz]..t: Report to the harbour captain in the chancery.

[kowal_i_rusznice].objectives.[rozstrzyg.t: Settle the matter on the spot: The Smith and His Handguns.

[kto_pali_w_zaulku].description.t: In Glassmakers' Alley someone sets fire to someone's workshop every night. The glassmakers say it's a coincidence, and the guards say it's the glassmakers. The scribe wants to know who is really doing it.

[kto_pali_w_zaulku].objectives.[rozlicz].t: Report to the scribe in the chancery.

[kto_pali_w_zaulku].objectives.[rozstrzy.t: Settle the matter on the spot: Fire in Glassmakers' Alley.

[kto_pyta_o_ocalalych].description.t: Scouts are hanging about the road, and one of them is asking the wrong questions. Find out who they're looking for and tell the commander.

[kto_pyta_o_ocalalych].objectives.[podsl.t: Listen in on the scouts at their campfire by the road (after dusk).

[kto_pyta_o_ocalalych].objectives.[rapor.t: Tell the commander what you've learned.

[kto_sprzedal_ocalalego].description.t: The reeve suspects someone hereabouts is selling newcomers' names to the Imperials. The wise woman and the smith ought to know something.

[kto_sprzedal_ocalalego].objectives.[sol.t: Tell the reeve who's been squealing to the Imperials.

[lek_dla_wrzoska].description.t: Wrzosek the innkeeper is nursing a hangover and pays for herbs from a forest glade.

[lek_dla_wrzoska].objectives.[zanies].te.t: Take the herbs to Wrzosek at the tavern.

[lek_dla_wrzoska].objectives.[ziola].tex.t: Gather herbs in the glade in Marchwood.

[list_dla_marszalka].description.t: On the quay lies a murdered runner with a letter inside his shirt. Addressed to the marshal. The scribe says it's none of his business, but asks you to see to it.

[list_dla_marszalka].objectives.[rozlicz.t: Report to the scribe in the chancery.

[list_dla_marszalka].objectives.[rozstrz.t: Settle the matter on the spot: A Letter for the Marshal.

[list_do_lesniczego].description.t: The commander wants a letter taken to the forester at the Forester's Lodge, two days' walk east, and an answer brought back. No reading it, naturally.

[list_do_lesniczego].objectives.[list].t.t: Take the letter to the forester at the Forester's Lodge.

[list_do_lesniczego].objectives.[odpowie.t: Bring the forester's answer to the commander.

[list_od_gonca].description.t: A wounded runner begs you to hide his military dispatch in an oak in Marchwood before the men who shot him catch up with him.

[list_od_gonca].objectives.[dostawa].tex.t: Hide the runner's letter in the old oak in Marchwood.

[listy_z_tamtej_strony].description.t: Jerzy the digger found a sealed imperial letter in a dead man's coat. Sister Halina at the Crossroads Shrine can read it.

[listy_z_tamtej_strony].objectives.[hali.t: Take the letter to Sister Halina at the Crossroads Shrine.

[listy_z_tamtej_strony].objectives.[kopa.t: Tell Jerzy the digger what the letter said.

[lodz_bez_zalogi].description.t: Someone has left a boat full of powder barrels in the Boat Graveyard. The harbour captain wants no part of it in his books, so he asks you to decide what to do with it.

[lodz_bez_zalogi].objectives.[rozlicz].t.t: Report to the harbour captain in the chancery.

[lodz_bez_zalogi].objectives.[rozstrzygn.t: Settle the matter on the spot: A Boat Without a Crew.

[mgla_ciszy].description.t: An imperial scout vanished in the Hollow of Silence, where the fog swallows every sound. Hieronim wants someone to find him.

[mgla_ciszy].objectives.[hieronim].text.t: Tell Hieronim the scout is alive.

[mgla_ciszy].objectives.[zwiadowca].text.t: Find the missing scout and lead him out of the fog.

[most_bez_straznika].description.t: The sentry from the Bridge on the Grey vanished together with his blanket, his mug and half the supplies. The captain wants to know what's become of the bridge, since both sides know it exists.

[most_bez_straznika].objectives.[rozstrz.t: Settle the matter on the spot: A Bridge Without a Guard.

[most_bez_straznika].objectives.[zameldu.t: Report to the captain in the command tent on how it went.

[mul_imieniem_cesarz].description.t: The tinker Ziemowit is looking for a grey mule named Emperor that ran off towards the burned village. Calling after him around the camp has already led to two interrogations.

[mul_imieniem_cesarz].objectives.[oddaj].t: Tell the tinker in the sutler's tent that Emperor is back.

[mul_imieniem_cesarz].objectives.[znajdz.t: Find the mule in the burned village.

[najemnik_w_karczmie].description.t: A sellsword has turned up at the tavern, asking after a survivor from the School of the Blade. You need to get rid of him or outfox him.

[najemnik_w_karczmie].objectives.[kruk]..t: Settle the matter of Raven the sellsword.

[notatnik_ucznia].description.t: A stray apprentice of Hieronim's asks you to take the notebook he dropped back to the apprentices' box at Starwatch.

[notatnik_ucznia].objectives.[dostawa].t.t: Drop the apprentice's notebook into the apprentices' box at Starwatch.

[odlamki_dla_zbieracza].description.t: Wacław the shard gatherer asks you to take a pouch of glass to his hideout in the Glass Field.

[odlamki_dla_zbieracza].objectives.[dost.t: Take the pouch of shards to Wacław's hideout in the Glass Field.

[ostatni_list_zolnierza].description.t: A dying soldier asks you to take his last letter to a grave by the Crossroads Shrine.

[ostatni_list_zolnierza].objectives.[dos.t: Lay the soldier's letter on the grave by the shrine.

[ostatnia_strazica_zlecenie].description.t: An old soldier who might take your side lives in the Last Watchtower. He can be won over with words, with rations, or with the memory of Wojmir.

[ostatnia_strazica_zlecenie].objectives..t: Talk to the old soldier in the Last Watchtower.

[paczka_dla_mlynarki].description.t: Sulisław, a travelling merchant, won't make it to the mill before dark and asks you to take a parcel to the miller's wife.

[paczka_dla_mlynarki].name.t: A Parcel for the Miller's Wife

[paczka_dla_mlynarki].objectives.[dostaw.t: Take the parcel to the miller's wife at the Old Mill.

[pamiec_kamieni].description.t: Twelve standing stones offer a bargain to anyone who comes near. Hieronim wants to know whether such bargains are worth taking.

[pamiec_kamieni].objectives.[kamien].tex.t: Go to the Standing Stones and hear what they say.

[przejscie_smyka].description.t: Nipper, who got onto the island nobody knows how, claims he knows a way into the Hetman's Camp that nobody remembers. The captain would rather not ask.

[przejscie_smyka].objectives.[rozlicz].t.t: Report to the harbour captain in the chancery.

[przejscie_smyka].objectives.[rozstrzygn.t: Settle the matter on the spot: Nipper's Passage.

[przemyt_z_portu].description.t: In the market a boy is watching a crate from the port that isn't his. The scribe says there are things inside he would rather nobody saw.

[przemyt_z_portu].objectives.[rozlicz].t.t: Report to the scribe in the chancery.

[przemyt_z_portu].objectives.[rozstrzygn.t: Settle the matter on the spot: Smuggling from the Port.

[przygotowania].description.t: The parting of the ways is near. Before you set out for the crater, say goodbye to Brygida and answer Hieronim's question.

[przygotowania].objectives.[brygida].tex.t: Say goodbye to Brygida in her workshop.

[przygotowania].objectives.[hieronim].te.t: Go back to Hieronim and answer his question.

[przyjecie_w_obserwatorium].description.t: Hieronim the stargazer doesn't like strangers, and Brygida likes them even less. Introduce yourself to both and go back to Hieronim with word that Brygida didn't run you off.

[przyjecie_w_obserwatorium].objectives.[.t: Meet Brygida the handywoman in her workshop.
Introduce yourself to Hieronim the stargazer.
Go back to Hieronim with word that Brygida didn't chase you off.

[przyjecie_w_osadzie].description.t: Nobody in Głuszec likes strangers, and Wawrzyn the reeve likes them least of all. Introduce yourself, find a bed for the night and go back to the reeve with the news, so there's no whispering behind your back.

[przyjecie_w_osadzie].objectives.[izba]..t: Rent a room at the Dead Cockerel.

[przyjecie_w_osadzie].objectives.[raport.t: Tell the reeve you've got a roof over your head.

[przyjecie_w_osadzie].objectives.[sol].t.t: Introduce yourself to Wawrzyn the reeve.

[rannego_nie_zostawia_sie].description.t: A prop gave way in the Quarry and buried a miner. Wincenty the caretaker can't dress his wounds and asks for help.

[rannego_nie_zostawia_sie].objectives.[d.t: Tell Wincenty the caretaker the miner is safe.

[rannego_nie_zostawia_sie].objectives.[r.t: Help the injured miner in the Quarry tunnel.

[rannych_sie_nie_liczy].description.t: The wounded lie on the field after yesterday's battle. The crows are already counting them. The command doesn't, because its ledger has no column for it.

[rannych_sie_nie_liczy].objectives.[rozs.t: Settle the matter on the spot: The Wounded Don't Count.

[rannych_sie_nie_liczy].objectives.[zame.t: Report to the captain in the command tent on how it went.

[rozpoznanie_urzadzenia].description.t: Brygida is drawing the device from Bald Rock down by the quay and wants you to see her sketches before you think of sailing. The captain asks you to hear her out.

[rozpoznanie_urzadzenia].objectives.[roz.t: Report to the harbour captain in the chancery.
Settle the matter on the spot: Studying the Machine.

[siodlo_dla_zwiadowcow].description.t: Przybysław the saddler asks you to deliver a package: a mended saddle is waiting for its owner at the place called the Merchants' Road.

[smyk_i_klucz].description.t: Nipper lost a key that is supposed to open something very important and very vague. He lost it in the Old Waterworks, three days' journey from here.

[smyk_i_klucz].objectives.[rozlicz].text.t: Report to the scribe in the chancery.

[smyk_i_klucz].objectives.[rozstrzygnij].t: Settle the matter on the spot: Nipper and the Key.

[studnia_pod_skjeldowem].description.t: The only well in the area lies in the burned village. Whoever holds it has the water and the movements of the troops. Someone has to go there and decide whom that water is to serve.

[studnia_pod_skjeldowem].objectives.[roz.t: Settle the matter on the spot: The Well Outside Skjeldowo.

[studnia_pod_skjeldowem].objectives.[zam.t: Report to the captain in the command tent on how it went.

[swiatlo_w_mlynie].description.t: Ostap swears something cold shines in the mill after dark. Look in at night and show the smith what you find.

[swiatlo_w_mlynie].objectives.[kowal].te.t: Show the shard to the smith at the forge.

[swiatlo_w_mlynie].objectives.[odlamek]..t: Find the glass shard in the mill at night.

[swiece_na_kapliczke].description.t: Tobiasz the chandler asks you to deliver a package: wax candles are waiting for their owner at the place called the Crossroads Shrine.

[szara_trzcina].description.t: Dobrawa the wise woman needs grey reed from the Greywater Marshes. Cutting it is noisy, and the birds give away anyone who comes near.

[szara_trzcina].objectives.[trzcina].tex.t: Gather grey reed in the Greywater Marshes.

[szara_trzcina].objectives.[zn].text.t: Take the reed to Dobrawa the wise woman.

[szklo_z_krateru].description.t: Hieronim is measuring how fast the shards from the Glass Field lose their memory. He needs three, each a different colour.

[szklo_z_krateru].objectives.[szklo].tex.t: Gather three glass shards in the Glass Field.

[watek_front].description.t: The Camp on Crow Mountain is not the end of the road. The captain needs hands, and Ulfgród, the capital, needs news that nobody there wants to hear.

[watek_front].objectives.[stolica].text.t: Collect the letter from the captain and set out for Ulfgród, the capital.

[watek_front].objectives.[sztab].text.t: Report to the captain in the command tent: someone has to help him in this mess.

[watek_front].objectives.[zlecenia].text.t: Settle at least three matters from the command's board: the captain must see that you're fit for it.

[watek_gluszec].description.t: In Głuszec someone is selling newcomers' names, and the old stones in the graveyard speak with a voice of their own. Piece it together, then set out for Starwatch on Glass Hill, two days north.

[watek_gluszec].objectives.[cmentarz].te.t: After dark, go to the Głuszec graveyard and listen to the voice from the stones.

[watek_gluszec].objectives.[halina].text.t: Tell Sister Halina at the shrine about the voice from the stones.

[watek_gluszec].objectives.[osada].text.t: Settle in: report to Wawrzyn the reeve.

[watek_gluszec].objectives.[trop].text.t: Find a trace of the survivors: look into the smoke on the hill, or find out who's selling names.

[watek_jarnowo].description.t: The island of smiths has a war it doesn't understand and a machine it understands even less. You have to find the man who started it and sail to Bald Rock, where it ends.

[watek_jarnowo].objectives.[brama].text.t: Sail to Bald Rock and decide the fate of the Vortex Gate before somebody decides for you.

[watek_jarnowo].objectives.[hetman].text.t: Talk to Hetman Skjeldomir in his tent in the Hetman's Camp.

[watek_jarnowo].objectives.[zlecenia].te.t: Settle at least three matters from the board on the quay, or find another way to the hetman: the hetman talks only to people he knows by hearsay.

[watek_jarnowo].objectives.[znajomi].tex.t: Report to the harbour captain in the chancery: the island doesn't like newcomers who don't know whom they answer to.

[watek_loch].description.t: The Emperor is dead, but what was written down with him still works beneath the palace. As long as the Core has someone to tend it, the city will not breathe easy. After that you will have to sail to Jarnowo Harbour.

[watek_loch].objectives.[niespiacy].text.t: Go down to the cell of the Sleepless, who stands between you and the Core.

[watek_loch].objectives.[rdzen].text.t: Enter the Core Chamber and talk with the Steward on its terms or on yours.

[watek_loch].objectives.[straznicy].text.t: Pass through the corridor beneath the palace and defeat three guardians: the Threshold, the Gallery of Whispers and the Cable Lock.

[watek_obserwatorium].description.t: The old imperial Starwatch knows the answers to questions you'd rather not ask. What's left is the trek to the crater, and after it the road to the Camp on Crow Mountain.

[watek_obserwatorium].objectives.[dlug]..t: Find out from Brygida what the core from the Machine Wreck is saying.

[watek_obserwatorium].objectives.[krater.t: Say goodbye to Brygida, answer Hieronim and head for the crater.

[watek_obserwatorium].objectives.[przyje.t: Introduce yourself to Hieronim and Brygida.

[watek_obserwatorium].objectives.[wypraw.t: Hieronim calls you to get ready: drop by the tower before you set out for the crater.

[watek_ulfgrod].description.t: Ulfgród knows more about you than you'd like. You need to find proof that you're alive, and a way to the man who doesn't leave the palace.

[watek_ulfgrod].objectives.[dowod].text.t: Get proof that you are alive and that you saw the tribute: Sister Jadwiga's seal in the House of Silence, or a forgery from the barracks quartermaster.

[watek_ulfgrod].objectives.[palac].text.t: Enter the palace at night by the servants' stairs and reach the throne room upstairs.

[watek_ulfgrod].objectives.[smyk].text.t: Tell Nipper that you have the proof: he is the one who opens the palace.

[watek_ulfgrod].objectives.[zlecenia].te.t: Settle at least three matters from the board and report to the scribe: nobody here trusts someone without a reckoning.

[watek_ulfgrod].objectives.[znajomi].tex.t: Talk to Hjalmar the innkeeper at the inn and to Nipper in the street: the city belongs to those who know it.

[watek_wilczy_brod].description.t: Wolf's Ford isn't the end of the road. There's business to settle in the village, and a deal to strike with Ostromir the merchant, who's travelling on, beyond Stone Pass.

[watek_wilczy_brod].objectives.[dlug].te.t: Go back to Wrzosek with word from Ostap: then he'll hand you the merchant's debt.

[watek_wilczy_brod].objectives.[ostap].t.t: Take a sack of grain to Ostap the miller (a job from the notice board).

[watek_wilczy_brod].objectives.[ostromir.t: Talk to Ostromir by the gate: he needs an escort to Stone Pass.

[watek_wilczy_brod].objectives.[przelecz.t: See Ostromir's wagon safely to Stone Pass.

[watek_wilczy_brod].objectives.[weksel]..t: Take Wrzosek's promissory note to Ostromir the merchant on the Merchants' Road.

[watek_wilczy_brod].objectives.[wrzosek].t: Talk to Wrzosek at the tavern: he has a merchant's debt to collect, but first he needs a hand.

[watek_wilczy_brod].objectives.[zwrot].t.t: Give Wrzosek the receipt from Ostromir.

[watek_wir].description.t: The rock is black glass on the inside and has only one reason to climb it. At the very top waits someone who has known for a long time that you'd come.

[watek_wir].objectives.[komnata].text.t: Enter the Whirl Chamber and face the Being.

[watek_wir].objectives.[progi].text.t: Pass the three thresholds of the Whirl: the gallery of mirrors, the coil hall and the walkway over the Whirl.

[wdowa_po_straznik].description.t: Ela's mother lives in Głuszec. Her husband once kept guard over the ruins, and she wants to know where he was buried.

[wdowa_po_straznik].objectives.[kopacz]..t: Ask Jerzy the digger where the guard from the ruins lies.

[wdowa_po_straznik].objectives.[wdowa].t.t: Tell Jaga the widow where her husband's grave is.

[wiesci_z_gluszca].description.t: News from Głuszec has reached Starwatch. You can send help or leave the village to its fate.

[wiesci_z_gluszca].objectives.[decyzja]..t: Talk to Hieronim about the news from Głuszec, and decide.

[wiesci_z_ladu].description.t: A messenger has reached the harbour with a sealed letter from the mainland. The captain says it's none of his business and asks you to deal with it.

[wiesci_z_ladu].objectives.[rozlicz].tex.t: Report to the harbour captain in the chancery.

[wiesci_z_ladu].objectives.[rozstrzygnij.t: Settle the matter on the spot: News from the Mainland.

[wilcza_nora].description.t: The commander pays twenty-five groats for the pack that's been carrying off sheep from under the palisade. The den is in a gully, a day's walk up the stream.

[wilcza_nora].scenes.[nora_po_walce].tex.t: The pack lies dead in a pool of blood. You cut off the ears for proof, because the commander won't take your word for it.

[wilcza_nora].scenes.[nora_ucieczka].tex.t: You back off down the gully, and the howling chases you all the way to the road. The pack stays in its den and isn't going anywhere, so you can come back when you're ready.

[wilcza_nora].scenes.[nora_wawoz].text.t: The gully stinks of carrion. Under the roots of an old beech the earth is dug up, and gnawed sheep bones lie white all around. Three pairs of eyes glint out of the dark.

[wino_dla_koszar].description.t: The barracks quartermaster is looking for barrels of wine for a feast nobody wants to keep. The scribe suspects the wine is needed so the soldiers won't hear what goes on behind the wall.

[wino_dla_koszar].objectives.[rozlicz].t.t: Report to the scribe in the chancery.

[wino_dla_koszar].objectives.[rozstrzygn.t: Settle the matter on the spot: Wine for the Barracks.

[wrak_maszyny].description.t: Brygida wants the core out of the Machine Wreck, but her hands are too thick for it. It'll take a careful hand or a strong one.

[wrak_maszyny].objectives.[rdzen].text.t: Take the core out of the Machine Wreck.

[zaginiona_karawana].description.t: Sieciech the carter came back alone from a caravan that vanished on the Old Road. He's looking for any trace of his men.

[zaginiona_karawana].objectives.[furman].t: Tell Sieciech the carter what you found.

[zaginiona_karawana].objectives.[woz].te.t: Find traces of the caravan in the gully by the Old Road.

[zaginiony_pasterz_borek].description.t: Borek the shepherd's wife hasn't seen her husband in three days. Look for tracks in the forest, find him and let his wife know.

[zaginiony_pasterz_borek].objectives.[bo.t: Find Borek in the Watchtower Ruins.

[zaginiony_pasterz_borek].objectives.[sl.t: Find Borek's tracks past the glade in Marchwood.

[zaginiony_pasterz_borek].objectives.[zo.t: Tell his wife that Borek is alive.

[zaginiony_skarbnik].description.t: The barracks treasurer vanished together with the barracks strongbox. The scribe suspects he's sitting in the House of Silence, since that's where everything hides that doesn't want to be found.

[zaginiony_skarbnik].objectives.[rozlicz.t: Report to the scribe in the chancery.

[zaginiony_skarbnik].objectives.[rozstrz.t: Settle the matter on the spot: The Missing Treasurer.

[zboze_dla_mlyna].description.t: A notice hangs on the board: someone wants rid of a sack of grain nobody wants and is looking for somebody to carry it to Ostap the miller. The miller probably has something to tell the innkeeper.

[zboze_dla_mlyna].objectives.[wiadomosc].t: Pass Ostap's message on to Wrzosek at the tavern.

[zboze_dla_mlyna].objectives.[zboze].tex.t: Take the sack of grain to Ostap the miller.

[zold_dla_garnizonu].description.t: The garrison in the fort ruins hasn't seen pay in two months. The captain presses a chest with the command's seal on you and asks you to deliver it. What's in it, you're not to ask.

[zold_dla_garnizonu].objectives.[rozstrz.t: Settle the matter on the spot: Pay for the Garrison.

[zold_dla_garnizonu].objectives.[zameldu.t: Report to the captain in the command tent on how it went.

[zold_w_kosciach].description.t: The cardsharp Mszczuj fleeced Corporal Żegota's squad of all their pay, sixty groats, and went off to the battlefield. The corporal wants the purse back and can't go after it, because of his leg.

[zold_w_kosciach].objectives.[odzyskaj]..t: Recover the purse with the pay from the cardsharp (wagon at the edge of the battlefield).

[zold_w_kosciach].objectives.[rozlicz].t.t: Settle up with Corporal Żegota in the sutler's tent.

[zwiad_na_wzgorzu].description.t: Bogdan the smith can see smoke on the hill beyond the shrine. Someone has to check who's camped up there and come back with news.

[zwiad_na_wzgorzu].objectives.[kowal].te.t: Tell Bogdan the smith what you saw.

[zwoj_dla_pustelnika].description.t: Anzelm the scholar asks you to deliver a package: a hermit's scroll is waiting for its owner at the place called the Fallen Star Crater.
